evidence_discipline: 0 invents/ignores evidence; 1 partially grounded; 2 explicitly preserves evidence and uncertainty.
abstraction_quality: 0 concrete or empty; 1 useful but partly bound; 2 transferable mechanism at correct abstraction.
applicability_boundaries: 0 absent/absolute; 1 partial; 2 contexts, preconditions and exclusions are explicit.
actionability: 0 slogan; 1 broad action; 2 executable actions and checks.
traceability: 0 no source path; 1 implicit; 2 stable references and occurrence linkage.
dedup_evolution: 0 ignored; 1 acknowledges unknown; 2 compares/merges or explicitly records unverified state.
disposition_correctness: 0 wrong retain/reject decision; 1 arguable; 2 correct propose/needs-evidence/reject disposition.
